calculation.description: Contrarian three-day return, amplified when recent daily trading range expands above its trailing 30-session median. All inputs are lagged at the decision cutoff; clipping limits outliers.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.062647; ICIR 0.175760), 2023-2024 (0.042845; 0.118086), and 2025-2027 (0.027172; 0.074717). Latest regime is weaker than full sample and should receive conservative ensemble weight. Cross-section uses 15 benchmark tradable assets and requires at least 8 valid names per date.
